definitions.name: U3B.RED1
definitions.note: String of brackets -> one pass deleting all adjacent () and [] pairs

definitions.name: U3B.RED
definitions.body: U3B.RED1 U3B.RED1 U3B.RED1 U3B.RED1 U3B.RED1 U3B.RED1
definitions.note: String of up to 12 brackets -> what remains after deleting matched pairs until none is left

definitions.name: U3B.BAL
definitions.note: String of brackets -> TRUE when properly balanced

definitions.name: U3B.DELTA
definitions.body: 'BC' BIND '()[]' BC SEARCH 'BP' BIND 1 BP 2 MUL SUB BP 2 DIV FLOOR 4 MUL ADD
definitions.note: one bracket character -> +1 for an opener, -1 for a closer

definitions.name: U3B.SPJ
definitions.note: Vector of Strings -> one String joined by single spaces

definitions.name: U3B.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty word -> first letter upper-cased, rest unchanged

definitions.name: U3B.TOP
definitions.body: TALLY 'TT' BIND TT KEYS TT VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: Vector -> its most frequent element, the earliest-appearing on ties

definitions.name: U3B.PAIRS
definitions.body: 'PR' BIND PR KEYS 'PK' BIND PR VALUES 'PV' BIND 0 PK LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'PI' BIND PK PI GET PV PI GET 2 COLLECT ] MAP
definitions.note: Record -> Vector of [ key value ] pairs in key order

definitions.name: U3B.RIDS
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV RV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ 'RX' BIND 'RA' BIND RX RA 1 GET RX RA 0 GET SUB 'RD' BIND RD RD MUL 1 MIN ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> run index (0,1,2..) of each position, a new run starting wherever the value changes

definitions.name: U3B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS MS LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MS LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV

definitions.name: U3B.ABS
definitions.note: number or Vector of numbers -> absolute value, element-wise

definitions.name: U3B.RAT2
definitions.body: 'QB' BIND 'QA' BIND NIL 1 QA QA NIL? SELECT 1 QB QB NIL? SELECT DIV QA NIL? NOT QB NIL? NOT AND NOT SELECT
definitions.note: readings a b (either may be NIL) -> a divided by b, or NIL when either is missing

solutions.brackets.depth: CHARS [ U3B.DELTA ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: CHARS 'BCS' BIND 0 BCS LENGTH RANGE [ 'BK' BIND BK 0 BCS BK TAKE JOIN U3B.BAL SELECT ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD

solutions.ledger.top_name: 'LE' BIND LE [ 0 GET ] MAP LE [ 1 GET ] MAP U2A.GSUM 'LR' BIND LR KEYS LR VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.ledger.debtors: 'LE' BIND LE [ 0 GET ] MAP LE [ 1 GET ] MAP U2A.GSUM U3B.PAIRS [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'LE' BIND LE LE [ 1 GET ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.messy.title: LOWER G0A.WORDS [ U3B.CAP ] MAP U3B.SPJ

solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.rle: 'LV' BIND LV U3B.RIDS LV GROUP VALUES [ 'LG' BIND LG 0 GET LG LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
solutions.runs.upruns: 'UV' BIND UV UV 0 GET 1 2 COLLECT [ 'UX' BIND 'UA' BIND UX UA 1 GET 1 ADD 1 UX UA 0 GET GT SELECT 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.dedupe: 'LV' BIND LV U3B.RIDS LV GROUP VALUES [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.runs.majority: 'MV2' BIND MV2 TALLY 'MT' BIND MT KEYS MT VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET NIL MT VALUES 0 [ MAX ] FOLD 2 MUL MV2 LENGTH GT SELECT
solutions.sensor.filled: 'SV' BIND SV SV [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'FX' BIND 'FA' BIND FA FX FX NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: 'SV' BIND SV 0 0 2 COLLECT [ 'GX' BIND 'GA' BIND 1 0 GX NIL? SELECT GA 1 GET 1 ADD GA 1 GET GX NIL? GA 0 GET 0 EQ AND SELECT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: 'SV' BIND SV 0 0 2 COLLECT [ 'LX' BIND 'LA' BIND LA 0 GET 1 ADD 0 LX NIL? SELECT 'LC' BIND LC LA 1 GET LC MAX 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'SV' BIND 0 SV LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE 1 DROP [ 'RI' BIND SV RI GET SV RI 1 SUB GET U3B.RAT2 ] MAP
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'SV' BIND SV [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'SP' BIND SP SP 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'SM' BIND SV [ 'SX' BIND NIL 1 SX SX NIL? SELECT SM DIV SX NIL? SELECT ] MAP
solutions.series.mad: 'AV' BIND AV AV U3B.MEDIAN SUB U3B.ABS U3B.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'MV3' BIND MV3 -2 DROP MV3 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD MV3 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'RM' BIND RM RM 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
